detail.title: Revised AI Dependency and Reduced Autonomy in Athletes
detail.summary: Empirical survey data from athletes reveals a serial association model linking AI training recommendation dependence to body signal outsourcing, reduced self-regulation, training decision hesitation, and diminished self-efficacy.
